name: benchmark-intelligence-platform
description: Deployment entry point for the AI Travel Benchmark Dashboard. Installs 10_Dashboard, 11_Benchmark_Engine, and 12_Provider_Layer (the Dashboard's server.js hard-imports the Engine's orchestrator and, via 13_Orchestrator, the Provider Layer's NavigationProvider, which depends on Playwright directly since Sprint 19), then starts the Dashboard server. Business logic lives in 10_Dashboard/, 11_Benchmark_Engine/, 12_Provider_Layer/, and 13_Orchestrator/ — this file only wires up deployment.

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:dashboard && npm run install:engine && npm run install:provider-layer && npm run install:browsers
